description: This source file implements the MIDI manager for Windows Runtime (WinRT) in Chromium, handling MIDI input/output ports, device enumeration, and message processing using Windows APIs and COM interfaces.

classes.name: MidiManagerWinrt
classes.description: Manages MIDI input and output ports on Windows using WinRT APIs, handles device enumeration, message reception, and data sending.

classes.name: MidiPortManager
classes.description: Template base class for managing MIDI ports, handling device watcher events, port creation, and message handling.

classes.name: MidiInPortManager
classes.description: Handles MIDI input ports, manages message reception and port state updates.

classes.name: MidiOutPortManager
classes.description: Handles MIDI output ports, manages data sending and port state updates.

methods.name: StartWatcher
methods.description: Starts device watcher to enumerate MIDI devices and listen for device changes.

methods.name: StopWatcher
methods.description: Stops the device watcher and cleans up event handlers.

methods.name: InitializeOnComRunner
methods.description: Initializes MIDI port managers and starts device enumeration on the COM task runner.

methods.name: DispatchSendMidiData
methods.description: Schedules sending MIDI data to the specified port with optional timestamp delay.

methods.name: SendOnComRunner
methods.description: Performs actual MIDI data transmission on the COM thread.

methods.name: OnPortManagerReady
methods.description: Called when MIDI port enumeration is complete and ports are ready.
